# wallhaven.cc

> > A community-driven wallpaper gallery featuring high-resolution images across anime, gaming, and art categories with user uploads, tagging systems, and active content moderation.

wallhaven.cc is a curated wallpaper platform that aggregates and organizes high-resolution images from various genres including anime, gaming, and digital art. The community actively participates in content curation, discussion, and moderation, including recent policies around AI-generated artwork.
